(2 comments)
Do you have a proposal in entity-manager schema change to support this?

Answered my own question, EM review here:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/entity-manager/+/69030
log message here also?
The getBusFromChannel function (in https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/75497) already logs a message with the issue. I don't think its necessary to log another message.
rather than duplicate the same logic (now that it becomes more complex), pull it into a common function

The logic is now done in a couple of common functions findMux and getBusFromChannel (in https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/75497) with each sensor that uses them modified to call those functions and create the necessary I2CMux and I2CBus objects.
